summary: Eventa (Polish event-organizer app) — full stack test. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering auth (register/login/me/duplicate/wrong-pw/short-pw), staff CRUD, event CRUD with server-side profit computation (labor=hours*hourly_rate, material=sum(costs), profit=revenue-total_cost), stats aggregation, and CSV export with Polish headers. Frontend: successfully registered a fresh user, redirected to /kalendarz, verified all 4 tabs (Kalendarz, Imprezy, Pracownicy, Statystyki) render correctly with Polish UI, PLN (zł) currency, dark+gold theme, month switcher on both Kalendarz and Statystyki, empty states + FAB on Imprezy/Pracownicy, logout icon on Pracownicy, and 'Eksportuj do CSV' button on Statystyki.

issues: Deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated — should migrate to 'boxShadow' for react-native-web. Cosmetic only.

action_items: Consider adding data-testid/testID attributes to all interactive elements (register-email, register-password, submit buttons, tab buttons, FABs, logout, export-csv) — currently tests must rely on placeholders/text which is brittle.
(Cosmetic) migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow to silence RN web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id in projections — good.
compute_event_summary loads staff via single $in query — efficient.
JWT_SECRET falls back to hardcoded dev secret if env missing — acceptable for MVP but should be enforced from env in prod.

CSV export endpoint requires Bearer header; mobile-side Linking.openURL will fail to download since backend does not accept ?token= query. Web fetch+blob approach works. Confirmed via curl-equivalent pytest — endpoint returns proper text/csv with Polish column names.
No pagination on list_events (limit=2000) — acceptable for MVP scale.

success_rate.frontend: 100% render/navigation; full event-creation UI flow not exercised end-to-end

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run registers a fresh user (test_<uuid>@eventa.pl) and cleans up its own staff/events via teardown. UI test registered one e2e_<uuid>@eventa.pl user (no cleanup — trivial).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (frontend/.env). Pytest suite located at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py. To reproduce end-to-end event creation UI, note the register/login screens are both mounted in DOM by Expo Router — use placeholder-based or last() selectors, not indexed input arrays. Add testID props for stable selectors.
